release_notes:
BD MIL OFFICE update 29 Sept 2026.
- New Pext tab. The extracted text box moved there, so PDF Edit now gives the viewer the whole screen.
- Scanner is now the second tab, next to PDF Edit.
- Burst Stack. Scan a pile with a blank sheet between each document, tap once, and each one is saved as its own PDF.
- Signature and stamp now burn exactly where you place them. Zoomed in, near a page break, or on a rotated page they used to land lower or on the wrong page.
- The green confirm tick is always reachable now, and a new red button discards a signature without burning it.
- Placing a signature no longer throws away unsaved handwriting without asking.
- Legal page size added to scan export.
- PowerPoint pictures no longer flicker.
- In landscape, buttons no longer hide behind the navigation bar.
- Scan Library is protected. It can no longer be wiped when the saved list cannot be read.
- Very large PDFs now tell you before editing instead of closing the app.
- Camera permission is genuinely gone. It survived in the last build by mistake.
- Leftover advertising code and the advertising ID permission removed. No ads, no tracking.
- Excel files are no longer offered to open, because the app cannot open them. CSV and .ppsx now open properly.
- If the update fails, uninstall the previous version and install this one.
